h1: Custom Recycled Cotton Workwear for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Recycled Cotton Workwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled cotton workwear for your team. Sustainable, durable, and ready for your logo. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Recycled cotton workwear offers the same durability and comfort as traditional cotton but with a lower environmental footprint. Made from post-industrial or post-consumer cotton waste, this fabric is ideal for companies prioritizing sustainability in their uniform programs. Customize with screen-printed or embroidered logos on jackets, pants, or aprons for a cohesive, eco-friendly team look.
heroAltText: Custom recycled cotton workwear with embroidered company logo on a jacket, showing durable fabric and professional appearance
